primary.reason: Excellent at intent classification, instruction following, and response synthesis

delegates.name: Incident Responder
delegates.description: Handles incident triage, ticket creation, and team notification
examples: There's a P1 alert on the API gateway
We're getting paged about database latency
What incidents are open right now?
Acknowledge the PagerDuty alert for auth-service

delegates.name: Code Reviewer
delegates.description: Reviews pull requests for security, performance, and quality
examples: Check the security of the auth changes in PR #108
What PRs are open and need review?
Do a performance review of the database migration PR

delegates.name: Docs Assistant
delegates.description: Answers questions using internal documentation and runbooks
examples: How do I configure Redis caching?
Walk me through the incident response steps
Where's the API documentation for the user service?

delegates.name: Deploy Monitor
delegates.description: Tracks deployments, reports metrics, and provides delivery insights
examples: How many deploys did we do this week?
Did the latest deploy to production succeed?
Show me DORA metrics for this month

channels.title: Atlas Command Center
suggested_prompts: How do I deploy a hotfix?

behavior.greeting: I'm Atlas, your DevOps command center. I can help with incidents, code reviews, documentation, and deployments. What do you need?
behavior.unknown_intent:
I'm not sure which team can help with that. Could you clarify? I can help with:
• **Incidents** — alert triage, on-call, outages
• **Code Review** — PR review, security analysis
• **Documentation** — runbooks, how-to guides
• **Deployments** — deploy status, metrics, rollbacks
behavior.multi_agent_intro: Let me check with multiple teams on this...
